setups.name: Fable 5.2 alone
setups.note: Stage 3 solo runs on the large feature: $14.54–19.65 and 36–51 min a run. First try counts runs with no fix round after review: 1 of 3 here, 5 of 7 pooled with the backlog runs (used for placement).

setups.name: Gemini 4 Argon alone
setups.note: Estimated from list price: Fable's measured tokens at Argon's $4/$20 per M from Dec 1 (~$4.25 at the $2/$10 promo until Nov 30). Time and first try are placed with Fable's until it is benchmarked.
